library.name: Concrete
library.text: You wake on cold concrete, tasting blood. Water drips in the dark. You remember nothing before the fall.

library.name: A Name
library.text: Lazarus. You remember your name. Your pockets are empty. A broken shaft opens above you.

library.name: No Sky
library.text: You throw a stone upward. Rubble falls back. The shaft has collapsed. There is no way up.

library.name: Red Light
library.text: A red lamp blinks. Your arm is bandaged. Someone helped you, but you cannot remember who.

library.name: Examine the fall site
library.text: Search the rubble for clues.

library.name: Check the dressing
library.text: Find out who dressed your wound.

library.name: Eight
library.text: A broken sign reads: NEST / MEDICAL SECTOR / 08. Eight levels underground.

library.name: A Trace
library.text: A furrow in the dust ends where you woke. You take a metal rod from the rubble.

library.name: The Knot
library.text: The knot is too neat to be yours. Someone treated you after the fall.

library.name: Stay Awake
library.text: Inside your cuff: DON’T SLEEP AGAINST THE WALL. The handwriting looks familiar. You steady your breathing.

library.name: Metal Rod
library.text: A short metal rod with a flattened end. Useful for prying.

library.name: The Last Shift
library.text: You force open a first-aid station. Dressings, an electrolyte ampoule, and an open locker.

library.name: Electrolyte Ampoule
library.text: You drink the sealed ampoule. Restore up to 2 energy.

library.name: Rubber Wedge
library.text: A rubber doorstop. Holds a door open or shut.

library.name: Ada’s ID Badge
library.text: ADA SHULZ / INFIRMARY. On the back: Oskar — engine room. The badge may still work.

library.name: Nest
library.text: THE NEST — INFIRMARY. Empty chairs. A duty terminal. Beyond a service door, something knocks steadily.

library.name: Read the duty terminal
library.text: Find out what happened here.

library.name: Look in the changing room
library.text: A medical coat hangs from an open locker.

library.name: Try the stairs up
library.text: Follow the arrow towards the surface.

library.name: Approach the service door
library.text: Find a way past the knocking.

library.name: Kogler
library.text: VICTOR KOGLER. 14 JAN 2041. Aggression. Rapid tissue growth. Screaming about butterflies. Consult Dr Steinfeld.

library.name: Alarm
library.text: Security alert: Armed personnel to level 8. This is not a drill. The clock stopped at 03:17.

library.name: Advice
library.text: A handwritten warning: They respond to sound. Do not speak to them.

library.name: Ada
library.text: A dead woman sits in the locker. Ada, stitched on her coat. Her body looks fresh; the dust does not.

library.name: The Last Recording
library.text: Her recorder plays: “Lifts disabled. Stairs barricaded. Oskar went to restore the main gate power. Ten hours ago.”

library.name: After the Voice
library.text: “There’s no way out. They’re getting closer.” The recording ends. You close the locker quietly.

library.name: Sealed
library.text: Collapsed stairs. An empty lift shaft. The surface is out of reach.

library.name: Protocol
library.text: LOCKDOWN. EXTERNAL ACCESS BLOCKED. A diagram points to the engine room below. You return to the waiting room.

library.name: Tremor
library.text: The wall trembles beneath your hand. Behind it, something seems to breathe in time with you.

library.name: Count your breaths
library.text: Separate your breathing from the sound behind the wall.

library.name: Step back and wait
library.text: Wait away from the wall. Lose 1 energy.

library.name: Breath
library.text: Your breathing slows. The other rhythm continues inside the vent. Now you can recognise it.

library.name: Lazarus
library.text: Someone calls your name. You turn, catching your wound on the doorframe. Nobody is there.

library.name: Distance
library.text: Away from the wall, the nausea fades. You check your cuff again: DON’T SLEEP AGAINST THE WALL.

library.name: The Courier
library.text: A one-armed courier circles a parcel trolley. A growth twitches on his neck. Every fourth step, his hip strikes metal.

library.name: Move with the knocks
library.text: Step only when the trolley knocks. Stay silent.

library.name: Wait for the pause in his breathing
library.text: Slip past during the pause in his breathing.

library.name: Slip behind the trolley
library.text: Pass behind him before he turns.

library.name: Squeeze into the drain
library.text: Crawl around the door through the drain. Lose 1 energy.

library.name: Delivery
library.text: You slip past. The courier stops beside the wall, still clutching a parcel. You keep moving.

library.name: Movement
library.text: Your boot catches a wrapper. The courier lunges. You shove the trolley between you and run.

library.name: The Spring
library.text: You slam the door. Two blows shake it. Then silence. Your arm is bleeding.

library.name: The Drain
library.text: You crawl beneath the knocking trolley and pull yourself out beside the medical airlock.

library.name: The Bolt
library.text: The airlock is locked. A badge reader glows. The drive cover hangs open. A narrow linen hatch offers another route.

library.name: Scan Ada’s badge
library.text: Try the badge reader.

library.name: Pry the bolt with the rod
library.text: Lever the bolt aside.

library.name: Bridge the emergency circuit
library.text: Power the bolt manually. Costs 1 energy.

library.name: Crawl through the linen hatch
library.text: Squeeze through the linen hatch. Lose 1 energy.

library.name: Welcome
library.text: WELCOME, ADA SHULZ. The airlock opens.

library.name: Weight
library.text: The rod bends. The bolt shifts just enough. You squeeze through.

library.name: What Hands Remember
library.text: Your hands choose the wires without hesitation. The bolt snaps back. What else do they remember?

library.name: A Spark
library.text: A spark burns your fingers. The mechanism dies. You crawl through the linen hatch instead.

library.name: On Your Knees
library.text: You crawl through the linen hatch. Beyond it, a communications terminal is ringing.

library.name: Contact
library.text: You answer the terminal. “Can anyone hear me? Juno-1. Emma Krause.”

library.name: Someone
library.text:
“Ada?”
“No. Lazarus.”
“Are you in Nest?”
“I think so. I don’t know how I got here.”

library.name: Two Days
library.text:
“I hid aboard Juno. Then cryosleep started. I’ve called for two days.”
“What level?”
“Lazarus, I’m in orbit.”
Behind you, the handle moves.

library.name: The Question
library.text: “Ada Shulz works in that infirmary,” Emma says. “Have you seen her? Is anyone still alive?”

library.name: Tell her what you found
library.text: “I found Ada. I’m sorry.”

library.name: Say you don’t know
library.text: “I haven’t found anyone alive.”

library.name: Promise to look for her
library.text: “I’ll look for her when it’s safe.”

library.name: A Name
library.text:
Emma falls silent.
“She called me Em.”
A breath.
“Thank you for telling me. Stay away from the main lifts.”

library.name: An Honest Answer
library.text:
“If you see her, tell her I waited.”
The handle moves again.
“Lazarus? What was that? Avoid the main lifts.”

library.name: Later
library.text: “Don’t risk it now. Find somewhere safe. Stay away from the main lifts.”

library.name: The Engine Room
library.text:
“Lockdown sealed the exits. Oskar went to restore gate power. Follow the yellow cables to the engine room.”
“Down?”
“For now.”

library.name: Emergency Channel
library.text:
“At the switch room, try channel seven. I’ll—”
TIME SYNC LOST.
A yellow cable leads into a hatch. Opposite it: a storeroom.

library.name: The Handle
library.text: The handle moves again. A service hatch leads down. A storeroom offers shelter. The way up is sealed.

library.name: Follow the yellow cable down
library.text: Follow the cable towards the engine room.

library.name: Wedge the door and descend
library.text: Leave the wedge under the door to buy time.

library.name: Hide in the storeroom
library.text: Barricade the storeroom and rest.

library.name: Level Eight
library.text: You climb into the hatch. The door crashes open above you. You keep descending.

library.name: Someone Is Waiting
library.text:
No memory. No way out. But Emma is waiting.
Channel seven. Engine room.
End of chapter: AWAKENING.

library.name: The Wedge
library.text: The wedge holds against the pressure. You descend, testing each rung.

library.name: Seven
library.text:
Two blows above. Then silence. You have a head start.
Engine room. Channel seven.
End of chapter: AWAKENING.

library.name: Shelter
library.text: You barricade the storeroom and sit away from the wall. Footsteps pause outside, then leave.

library.name: A Plan
library.text:
Rest first. Then the yellow cable, the engine room, channel seven.
End of chapter: AWAKENING.

library.name: Sterile dressing
library.text: Clean and dress your wound. Restore up to 2 health.

nodes.name: 08B · A Voice That Is Not Yours
